name: Embed Outline
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Remembers folds when switching between notes in an open panel.
Keeps folds when unrelated headings are inserted.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
The outline now remembers folded sections when you switch between notes.
Folded sections stay folded when you add other headings to the note.
tip: Click a heading row in an embedded note to scroll to that heading inside the embed.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Embed Outline is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it.
